verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents a public REST API for setting up pipelines and managing the account programmatically, publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.1 spec that generates its API reference, and keeps dated changelog entries with deprecation sunset dates. One older community comment calls the APIs unreliable, but that does not contradict that a documented public API exists. Missing for 10: a standalone versioning or breaking-change policy, and independent hands-on corroboration of API reliability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Set up and scale your data pipeline, and manage your Fivetran account programmatically using the Fivetran REST API.
Fivetran publishes a dedicated "OpenAPI Definition (V1)" page with direct JSON and YAML downloads of the full REST API specification, from which the API reference is auto-generated.
The spec file itself downloads as OpenAPI 3.0.1 (info version "v1"), covering the /v1 REST API.
